title: Store.List(author) ignores its author argument
evidence: main.go:83 List(author string) queries all rows unconditionally; the ?author= filter is instead applied in the handler at main.go:210-218
suggestion: Either filter in SQL (WHERE author = ?) or drop the unused parameter to avoid a misleading signature

title: In-place filter aliases the slice backing array
evidence: main.go:211 filtered := books[:0] reuses books' backing array; harmless here since books is discarded, but a foot-gun if the pre-filter slice were reused
suggestion: Allocate a fresh slice for the filtered result for clarity

title: Test coverage 65.8% — error/404/400 branches largely unexercised
evidence: scores.json test_coverage=0.658; tests cover happy paths + one validation reject, but not invalid-id (main.go:227), invalid-JSON (main.go:187), or GET-not-found on a missing id
suggestion: Add tests for 400 (bad id / bad JSON) and 404 (missing book) paths to raise coverage
